prompt: Solve the inequality $x + 5 > 9$. Write your answer like "x > 4".
hint: An inequality is solved with the same moves as an equation. What undoes adding $5$?

hints.text: An inequality is solved with the same moves as an equation. What undoes adding $5$?
Subtract $5$ from both sides and keep the $>$ sign pointing the same way: $x > 9 - 5$.

explanation: Subtract $5$ from both sides, just as you would for an equation. Subtracting never changes the direction of the sign.
That leaves $x > 9 - 5$, which simplifies to the solution $x > 4$.
Any number bigger than $4$ works. For example $x = 5$ gives $5 + 5 = 10$, and $10 > 9$ is true.

alternativeExplanations.title: On a number line
steps: Picture a number line with an OPEN dot at 4 (4 itself is not included).
Shade everything to the right — those are all the numbers whose "+5" beats 9.
